stage_1_atomization.policy: Each public segment was treated as an atomic proposition carrying document id, source tier, group id, arrival/version language, and claim status.

stage_2_schema_mapping.policy: Used the fixed public target_tables as the output schema; did not infer hidden columns.

stage_3_version_aware_generation.r12_match_0042_correction_log: Accepted the scorer-log transcription selected by the correction log and signed return; ignored broadcast cache repetitions and unauthenticated widgets.
stage_3_version_aware_generation.r12_match_0100_archive_crosswalk: Accepted blue-shelf first digest entries and copper-shelf second digest entries per the competition records memorandum; ignored morning-report broadcast discrepancies.
stage_3_version_aware_generation.r12_match_0069_exception_appendix: Accepted active appendix-keyed worksheet readings over compiled-body or copied-history readings; ignored unkeyed copied paragraphs.
